title: The Inner Circle
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Deangelo announces swift and strict changes in the office, aiming to identify genuine workers and enforce a new tone. He struggles to build rapport with Dwight and introduces Jordan as his new executive assistant, sparking concerns about sexism and office dynamics. The concept of an 'inner circle' is debated among employees, with some denying and others claiming its existence. Jim faces awkward confrontations and is eventually kicked out of this inner circle. The episode culminates in a basketball dunk exhibition where Deangelo injures himself, leading to an ambiguous outcome.
